data.name: Operation Anti-Robot
data.detailed_description:
OPERATION ANTI-ROBOT - AN ENDLESS 2D PLATFORMER

What this game is about:

The forest is being attacked by a secret force of technology, who sends robots, drones, lasers and many more things to try and eradicate any inhabitant. When the Narrator asks your help as a Creature of the Forest, you decide to endure the never-ending attacks as long as you can and stop the robots from marching onward!

Gameplay:

Operation Anti-Robot is a 2D Platformer endless wave survival game, where you try to dodge and block increasing amounts of attacks to survive and stall the robots onmarching as long as you can. Defeat bosses, upgrade your character and enhance your stats to increase survivability!

The longer you survive, the more Life Essence (in-game currency) you will gain, that will help you get stronger and endure longer and longer waves of enemies, and even defeat bosses. 

Climb up in the world and show everyone, that you are the nimblest Forest Creature out there!

Online Features:

Play against other players passively (actual PvP might come soon), by beating their highscores and reaching the top of the leaderboard! Work together with all players to finish a Global Challenge that will greatly benefit all players!

SEASON 1 - Murmurs of Danger

The forest is uncertain. There are rumors about shiny, silver metal boxes surrounding the entire biome. "I saw them! Some of them even fly! Others roll.. or walk..!" 

Start freshly into the first season, where players can compete to get into the leaderboard and win rewards. Also play together in the Global Challenge, by displaying your teamwork and getting rewarded grandly.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
